instruction: A candid documentary wide shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet, white walls, and pillars. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, his right hand resting on the shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the right facing him. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor. The camera is positioned at eye level, capturing both subjects in full-body view.
elements: R1 rests his right hand on R2's shoulder
R2 receives the hand-on-shoulder contact from R1
R1 and R2 face each other during the shoulder contact
the interaction takes place in an indoor motion capture studio

questions.q: Is R1 the person resting his right hand on R2's shoulder, rather than R2 resting her hand on R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1 initiates the shoulder contact on R2

questions.q: Is R2 the person whose shoulder is being touched by R1's hand, rather than R1 being the one whose shoulder is touched by R2?
questions.element: R2 receives the shoulder contact from R1

questions.q: Does R1 make contact using his right hand on R2's shoulder, rather than R2 making right-hand contact on R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1's right hand is the contacting hand
